In 2019, Frederik Keysers and Roy Jeunen started working on the idea of simplifying identity and access flows. Whenever they visited an industrial site (background in aviation, logistics and port facilities) they encountered the same problem. They had to arrive 15 to 45 minutes in advance to have their IDs checked/scanned, go through safety briefings and attend safety trainings. In addition, they were given insecure RFID badges as an access control method.

In August 2020, they founded Nine Engineering with the mission to simplify identity and access flows, improving site security, and increasing facility safety. To further develop their solution, Nine Engineering received initial funding from the European Space Agency (ESA) through the ESA BIC programme and VLAIO. Based on research and an iterative process with customers, the company launched NineID� in 2021. The solution consists of a SaaS platform where user data (ID documents, training, certificates) can be collected in a privacy-compliant way, even before the individual is on the site.Upon arrival, the NineID� XS1 hardware can grant access to doors, barriers and gates based on facial authentication, QR code or smartphone scanning (all in one device). This combination provides an end-to-end digital access flow with high levels of security. 

In May 2022, Nine Engineering raised �1.1 million to continue their commercial growth. 

In September 2022 the company received the Outstanding Security Performance (OSPA) Award for Outstanding New Security Product. The company is in a final stage to become ISO27001 and ISO27701 certified by December 2022. At the moment the company has 7 employees and an annual turnover of �217.000.

The Program Center SIX, with its headquarters in Ditzingen, Germany, comprises the Business Units "Radio Communication Products" (RCP), "Protection Systems" (PRS), "Network & Infrastructure Systems" (NIS) and "Crypto Defense Solutions" (CDS). Product and system solutions are offered in the defence and security sector. The portfolio for the defence sector includes combined tap-proof multi-band troop radio systems, complex command and control information and reconnaissance systems, tactical radio and command and control systems for mobile operations, software defined radios (SDR), systems for tactical reconnaissance and data evaluation, communication and navigation systems for surface ships, training systems and systems for field camp protection.
Another core area of activity is the development of new dish management systems for use in national and international system solutions for the civil and military market.
The portfolio is rounded off by activities in the field of after-sales. Since, on the one hand, the equipment in use by the German Armed Forces must remain operational for years to come and, on the other hand, equipment in the civilian sector must be sustainably maintained, this results in orders for the elimination of obsolescence, which require a highly specialised development effort.

The company is starting work and development of space based communications hardware related to remote sensing, communications systems as well as contributed to the development of the first Slovenian remote sensing satellite NEMO-HD.

APO-GEE ENGINEERING specializes in ball bearing engineering in aerospace industry (www.apo-gee.tech).

because success of space missions can no longer be dependent on ball bearing failure.

Ball bearing is without doubt one of the most widespread mechanical components. But when a ball bearing is subjected to high speeds, heavy loads or a harsh external environment, its behavior remains misunderstood.

Under these extreme conditions, bearings may become unstable or deteriorate. Many space missions have been disrupted or even aborted, precisely because of bearing performance problems, with very serious consequences in scientific, technical, political and, above all, financial terms.

The common feature of most bearing damage is the kinematics of the balls. However, this kinematics is difficult to understand and to model accurately. In fact, it had never been properly described to date. We did.
In particular, we have solved the CAGE INSTABILITY PROBLEM, to which no fully satisfactory response has been possible for more than 50 years (patent pending EP22191261).

WE WORK WITH:
- SPACE AGENCIES

- SATELLITE LAUNCH COMPANIES

- AIRCRAFT MANUFACTURERS

- EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURERS (REACTION WHEELs RWA, TURBO PUMPS...)

Based on an original kinematic and power based analysis, APO-GEE is able to accurately and completely characterize the movement of the balls within a bearing, and model the complete equilibrium of the bearing.

We can therefore analyze the phenomena specific to your applications in depth, provide tailor-made solutions for your applications, and thus ensure the success of your aerospace projects and missions.

Company description: APO-GEE ENGINEERING specializes in ball bearing engineering in aerospace industry (www.apo-gee.tech).

because success of space missions can no longer be dependent on ball bearing failure.

Ball bearing is without doubt one of the most widespread mechanical components. But when a ball bearing is subjected to high speeds, heavy loads or a harsh external environment, its behavior remains misunderstood.

Under these extreme conditions, bearings may become unstable or deteriorate. Many space missions have been disrupted or even aborted, precisely because of bearing performance problems, with very serious consequences in scientific, technical, political and, above all, financial terms.

The common feature of most bearing damage is the kinematics of the balls. However, this kinematics is difficult to understand and to model accurately. In fact, it had never been properly described to date. We did.
In particular, we have solved the CAGE INSTABILITY PROBLEM, to which no fully satisfactory response has been possible for more than 50 years (patent pending EP22191261).

WE WORK WITH:
- SPACE AGENCIES

- SATELLITE LAUNCH COMPANIES

- AIRCRAFT MANUFACTURERS

- EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURERS (REACTION WHEELs RWA, TURBO PUMPS...)

Based on an original kinematic and power based analysis, APO-GEE is able to accurately and completely characterize the movement of the balls within a bearing, and model the complete equilibrium of the bearing.

We can therefore analyze the phenomena specific to your applications in depth, provide tailor-made solutions for your applications, and thus ensure the success of your aerospace projects and missions.

Geodetski zavod Celje d.o.o. (GZC) is a Slovenian private company founded in 1955. With more than 65 years of experiences we are successfully providing consultations and technical assistance services to public sector financed programs and private sector. GZC is specialist in land management, cadastral, topographic, photogrammetric and GIS services, spatial and rural development programming, implementation, monitoring and evaluation and in the provision of technical assistance for capacity building of national and local institutions promoting spatial, agricultural and rural development. The company is one of the leading providers of technical assistance to many Ministries in Slovenia and within potential candidates and candidate countries in the Western Balkans. Company has experience in world Bank Loan funded projects and EU founded projects (Phare, IPA).
The Company has more than 70 employees and has managed numerous projects and programs in Slovenia and abroad. GZC is the only contractor for all on the spot controls and Controls with Remote Sensing in Slovenia since 2006, sharing its experiences also in Balkan and other countries. entityDescription:
VIGO Photonics SA is a world leader in the production of uncooled, infrared photon detectors. In the 80s, at the Military Technical Academy, a team led by prof. dr. hab. Joseph Piotrowski developed a unique technology for the production of detectors working without cryogenic cooling and then implemented it into a newly created company.
Detectors produced in VIGO are used in various areas such as:
-railways (detection of faults of high speed trains while in motion)
-Energy (verification of the status of the transmission infrastructure of electricity)
-Military technology (observation and targeting systems for unmanned flying objects, smart and homing munitions)
-Medical (detection of early stage cancer markers, cancer changes in soft tissue or disorders of the blood circulation system).
-Industry (energy optimization).
The status of the official supplier of components for the US space agency NASA is the confirmation of unique market position of VIGO. In cooperation with NASA VIGO developed and produced detectors working on the rover Curiosity exploring the surface of Mars.
The special asset of the company is the ability to combine research and development in the field of infrared technology with the production, in close cooperation with the user.
VIGO Photonics SA does not forget about its roots – for many years in the joint laboratory, VIGO has conducted advanced research works on new types of infrared detectorsin cooperation with scientists from the Military University of Technology and other domestic and foreign research institutions.
